claims.title: The elder event and p_r
claims.statement: For fixed pins M, S and a sample f let d_f(M) = sup{ min_t f(gamma(t)) : gamma(0) = M, f(gamma(1)) > f(M) } (empty supremum -infinity). The elder event is {d_f(M) = f(S)} on the Morse distinct-value locus; it is Borel in f for fixed pins, and p_r(b,k,R) := Q^W_r(elder event). Theorems A, B, C, E1, the dimension lift and Theorem U all refer to this p_r (P l.29, l.290-297; EL section 1 "exactly the p_r definition").
claims.evidence: P section 8 with the E2 section-9 replacement; reads REV-G1, REV-C1 (section 8 and E2 C1-C6), REV-G2. Formal: the deterministic level sets are Lean definitions (CFE-LEAN connectionLevels l.124, joinedLevels l.211, olderPeakLevels l.332); the sample-path event and its Q^W-measure are not formalized; in the statement register p is a primitive field (LIFETIME-LEAN l.457-467).
obligations: Formal: define the elder event as a set of sample paths and p_r as its Q^W-measure. This needs the regression law Q_r as a measure on smooth functions; the register classifies the parent Props as Mathlib-blocked (REG-README, REG-SCOPE).

claims.title: Deterministic cap theorem: CAP (1) on the cylinder forces the global elder partner
claims.statement: Let f be C^4 near D = [-2r,2r] x closedBall(0,2r) with critical pins M = (-r/2,0), S = (r/2,0), f(M) - f(S) = k r^3, lambda_min(-D_y^2 f(M)) > (4/(3k)) r M3^2 and r M4 <= 3k/10. Then on C = [-2r, r/2] x closedBall(0,2r): (C1) f <= f(M) on C; (C2+) f <= f(S) on the frontier of C with equality only at S; (C3) a path from M through S to a point z with f(z) > f(M) along which f >= f(S). Hence d_f(M) = f(S); on a compact locally connected space the largest level at which the closed-superlevel component of M contains a strictly higher local maximum is f(S). D contains exactly the critical points M and S, and every path from M to a higher point crosses the frontier of C, so no critical point elsewhere changes the pairing.
claims.evidence: Kernel-checked: CFE-LEAN ridge_capHyp_E (l.3162), torus_capHyp_blocks (l.5214), torus_elder_death_level_blocks (l.5256), axioms propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound only (CFE-MANIFEST), Lean author session_017. Prose: CAP sections 2-5, read by REV-C1 and re-derived by REV-SP (both session_017). MANIFEST: mathematical_acceptance false, alignment_review NOT_CLAIMED.
obligations: Nonauthor alignment review of the Lean statements against CAP sections 1-5 (the Lean author is the same session as both prose reviewers).
